nominee.longerDescription: Happy ww! My nominee is named Jorja Smith and she is a singer and songwriter from the UK. She is quite popular in the UK and she became famous when she was featured on Drake's 2017 album titled More Life. (man what a time that was..) The song was quite good and after that I later on liked a few of her other songs too and then I randomly saw what she looks like and I was shocked. Where has she been hiding before??? Later on I also found out Drake wanted to or potentially hit that before and he really wanted her but apparently she just used him for clout. With her figure I would allow it personally... Second pic is the photo she randomly had on one of the songs of hers I was listening to that made me look up what she looks like lol
